EXISTS vs IN and correlated subqueries

EXISTS checks whether a subquery has a row. IN tests membership. Optimizers can transform either;
NULL behavior differs, especially for NOT IN.
EXISTS එක matching row එකක් තිJයනවද බලනවා. IN එක list membership පරීක්ෂා කරෙනවා. NOT IN
Find customers who have not ordered.
NOT EXISTS matching customer_id orders o · customers c

Interview question: Is EXISTS always faster than IN?
Answer: No; performance depends on plan, indexes and data.
Remember: EXISTS tests presence; IN tests membership.
Practice: Find products never ordered using NOT EXISTS.
